Ooredoo Algérie, en sa qualité d'entrepr: Ooredoo Algeria, as a corporate citizen, has expressed its deep solidarity with the victims of the fires that affected several wilayas across the national territory. The operator also extended its condolences to the families of the victims.
Face à cette situation difficile, Ooredo: Faced with this difficult situation, Ooredoo Algeria reaffirms its commitment to contributing to national solidarity efforts. In this context, and in accordance with the instructions of the Ministry of Post and Telecommunications, the company announces free calls to all networks as well as free internet access for seven days for its customers residing in the disaster-stricken wilayas. These measures aim to facilitate staying in touch with loved ones and to support communication during this critical period.
Parallèlement, Ooredoo Algérie prévoit l: At the same time, Ooredoo Algeria plans to launch several solidarity initiatives aimed at the hardest-hit wilayas. These actions are part of a comprehensive approach to help and support affected populations.
À cette occasion, M. Roni Taamé, directe: On this occasion, Mr. Roni Taamé, CEO of Ooredoo Algeria, stated: "On behalf of Ooredoo Algeria and all our employees, I offer our sincere condolences to the families of the victims of these fires. We also send our deep sympathy to all those affected by this painful ordeal. In these difficult circumstances, as a corporate citizen, it is our duty to stand alongside our fellow citizens and contribute to collective efforts. Free communications and internet for seven days in the concerned wilayas, as well as the solidarity initiatives we are launching, reflect our willingness to provide concrete help to the disaster-stricken populations. Ooredoo Algeria will remain fully committed to standing by citizens and will continue to contribute to solidarity efforts to support the affected populations."
Ces mesures s'inscrivent dans la volonté: These measures are part of Ooredoo Algeria's desire to reaffirm its unwavering commitment to the service of national solidarity. The operator reiterates its support for citizens and its determination to contribute to social cohesion efforts in times requiring solidarity and mutual aid.
